What I object to is the suggestion that my data is going to be sold to anyone who wants it - in fact I personally believe there should be a law against this, similar to the EU Data Directive. And not "if they click on an okay button then go ahead" - I'm talking HIPAA-level "if you sell personally identifiable data to a third party then your executives go to prison."

You can sell properly anonymized data (this is harder than it sounds) or you can leverage data analysis for advertising on your site. That's it.

(Yes, it gets far more complex than this, and there are a lot of nuances, but you should get the general idea)
